snippet.title: L8R SK8R Trailer
snippet.description:
L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by classic fifth generation games like Crash Bandicoot and Mario 64.

Although instead of collecting crystals or stars you collect time. Finish levels as fast as you can to unlock new areas in the hub world. Wall ride and double jump your way through 25 levels set across history and feel like a speedrunner.

If that interests you, please conisder wishlisting on steam! (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046610/L8R_SK8R/)
